title: Keys of Stage Output Records
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ map the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs, let $0<\\tau\\le1$, and let $k<n$. For a finite family $A$ of coordinate subsets, set $C=\\bigcup_{S\\in A}\\{S,S\\cup\\{k\\}\\}$ and $J=\\{0,\\ldots,k\\}$. In every possible output trace of the stage run with target $f$, the sequence of pairs consisting of each record's coordinate set and frequency prefix is exactly the list of pairs $(J,U)$ as $U$ ranges over the list of elements of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs
$A$ is a finite family of coordinate subsets
the outcome lies in the support of the stage run with target $f$
